prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE finished ORIGINAL landscape 3:2 illustration for Aventura Lectora, a monochrome e-ink fantasy videogame. Full scene reaches all edges. Polished storybook art: smooth thick pure-BLACK rounded contours, bold readable creature silhouette, white and two flat gray tones, clean cel shading. Slightly chibi proportions but serious hostile enemies, not smiling or baby-cute. No pencil, hatching, pixel art, photorealism, gradients or heavy dark background. Readable at 480x320. No text, lettering, captions, UI, borders, watermark. The playable hero and PET are OFF CAMERA: first-person explorer viewpoint, works with any gender/outfit. No villagers, NPCs, librarian, companions, bell, songbook, letter from Ada or old plot relics. The only figure is the enemy described (monstrous armored knights are allowed). Do NOT add a random wolf when another creature is specified. Exactly one complete scene, NOT a sprite sheet or collage. Current region: The War for the Books. Path episode: The archive entrance. Story action, which the scene must directly support: You reach the archive as a monster tries to destroy the books inside.
Enemy identity, MUST match this exact anatomy: a low chariot-like ram creature made of broken wheels and heavy shields. Eye-level approach across foreground stones, enemy full-body in the center-right, destination visible behind. Show its surroundings and the specific obstacle from this episode, NOT the generic regional backdrop. Its exact enemy design takes precedence over vague words such as guardian/beast in the story. Do not show the monster already defeated. No gore. Do not add objects from earlier plots.
